name: Creekside Plaza

description: Creekside Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 2400 Southeast Green Oaks Boulevard in Arlington, Texas. Anchored by a Kroger grocery store, this community-focused plaza serves as a reliable destination for everyday shopping needs in the southeast Arlington area. The center maintains extended operating hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, providing flexibility for early morning shoppers and those with busy evening schedules. With a strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 1,200 reviews, Creekside Plaza has established itself as a trusted neighborhood retail destination. The center's accessible location along Green Oaks Boulevard makes it a convenient stop for local residents seeking grocery shopping, services, and everyday retail needs in a familiar, easy-to-navigate setting.
